mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, TO_CHAR(P.COURSE_NO) AS COURSE_NO, P.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME((SELECT SC.PARENT_CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE SC WHERE SC.CODE_NO = P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME, P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.COURSE_NUMBER, TO_CHAR(P.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_STARTDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS PLAN_STARTDATE, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_ENDDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS PLAN_ENDDATE, TO_CHAR(P.CLASS_HOUR) AS CLASS_HOUR, TO_CHAR(P.CLASS_UNIT) AS CLASS_UNIT, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_CODE_NAME, P.ISNOT_TEST, P.ISNOT_APPLY, P.DES_DEPARTMENT, P.DES_EMPLOYEE, P.DES_EMPLOYEE_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.BUDGET) AS BUDGET, P.BUDGET_SHOW, P.DEPART_MANA_CODE, GET_DEPT_NAME(P.DEPART_MANA_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPART_MANA_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.TEACHER_NAME) AS TEACHER_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.TEACHER_NAME_EMPID) AS TEACHER_NAME_EMPID, P.TRAIN_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(P.TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT) AS TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT, P.TRAIN_PERSON_REMARK, P.ISNOT_EVALUATE, P.ISNOT_REPORT, P.ISNOT_AGREEMENT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS S WHERE S.PLAN_NO = P.PLAN_NO AND S.ACTIVITY = 1) AS SYLLABUS_COUNT FROM EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P
mapper.select:
WHERE P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND P.ACTIVITY <> 0
AND P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT SC.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE SC WHERE SC.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{trainDiffCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE = #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(P.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
ORDER BY P.PLAN_NO DESC
WHERE P.PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T.EMPID, T.TEACHER_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME FROM EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER T LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.ACTIVITY = '1'
AND (T.EMPID = #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(T.TEACHER_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
ORDER BY T.TEACHER_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_PLAN_MANAGER (PLAN_NO, TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, COURSE_NAME_CODE, PLAN_STARTDATE, PLAN_ENDDATE, CLASS_HOUR, CLASS_UNIT, PERIOD_TIME, TRAIN_FORM_CODE, ISNOT_TEST, ISNOT_APPLY, DES_DEPARTMENT, DES_EMPLOYEE, BUDGET, BUDGET_SHOW, DEPART_MANA_CODE, TEACHER_NAME, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, DES_EMPLOYEE_NAME, TEACHER_NAME_EMPID, TRAIN_ADDRESS, TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT, ISNOT_EVALUATE, ISNOT_REPORT, ISNOT_AGREEMENT, COURSE_NUMBER, TRAIN_PERSON_REMARK, COURSE_NO) VALUES (#{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trainDiffCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{planStartdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{planEnddate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{classHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{classUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{periodTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isnotTest, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isnotApply, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{desDepartment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{desEmployee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{budget, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{budgetShow, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{departManaCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teacherName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{desEmployeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teacherNameEmpid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainPersonCount, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isnotEvaluate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isnotReport, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isnotAgreement, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainPersonRemark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_PLAN_MANAGER SET PLAN_STARTDATE = TO_DATE(#{planStartdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), PLAN_ENDDATE = TO_DATE(#{planEnddate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), CLASS_HOUR = #{classHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLASS_UNIT = #{classUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_FORM_CODE = #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISNOT_APPLY = #{isnotApply, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_DEPARTMENT = #{desDepartment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_EMPLOYEE = #{desEmployee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DES_EMPLOYEE_NAME = #{desEmployeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BUDGET = #{budget, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BUDGET_SHOW = #{budgetShow, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DEPART_MANA_CODE = #{departManaCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACHER_NAME = #{teacherName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACHER_NAME_EMPID = #{teacherNameEmpid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_ADDRESS = #{trainAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_PERSON_COUNT = #{trainPersonCount, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_PERSON_REMARK = #{trainPersonRemark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISNOT_EVALUATE = #{isnotEvaluate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(T.BASIC_NO) FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION T WHERE T.PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION SET ACTIVITY = '0' WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_STUDENT_CHECK WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_TEACHER_CHECK WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_COST_MANAGER WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_FINAL_STUDENT WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ACTIVITY = '1' AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM EDU_TRAIN_MAKER WHERE APPLY_NO IN (SELECT A.APPLY_NO FROM EDU_STUDENT_APPLY A WHERE A.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
DELETE FROM EDU_STUDENT_APPLY WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(S.SYLL_NO) AS SYLL_NO, TO_CHAR(S.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, S.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS COURSE_DATE, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_START_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS COURSE_START_TIME, TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_END_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS COURSE_END_TIME, S.DETAIL_ADDRESS FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS S WHERE S.PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND S.ACTIVITY = 1 AND S.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY S.COURSE_DATE, S.COURSE_START_DATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ACTIVITY = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS (SYLL_NO, PLAN_NO, COURSE_NAME_CODE, COURSE_DATE, COURSE_START_DATE, COURSE_END_DATE, DETAIL_ADDRESS, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID) VALUES (EDU_TRAIN_SYLL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{courseDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{courseDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{courseStartTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{courseDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{courseEndTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), #{detailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
